title: Takemi Program in International Health
institution: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
about: The Takemi Program in International Health at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health in Boston, United States, accepts applications for its 2027–2028 fellowship year (August to June). Applications are open until midnight EST on 31 December 2026.
requirements: Generally mid-career applicants who have completed graduate degrees, published in internationally recognized journals and shown leadership potential
Three references willing to submit letters of recommendation
